title: On the pseudorandom properties of filtered Legendre symbol sequences using three polynomials
summary: The primary objective of this section is to demonstrate that the actual pseudorandom measures of our construction are significantly smaller than the theoretical upper bounds derived from the Weil theorem. Regarding the family of sequences, we note that the construction $E_{f,g,h}$ allows for a large variety of sequences by choosing different triples of polynomials.
